name: Banner
description: A widget that displays a diagonal message (banner) across a corner of another widget. Useful for showing labels such as 'NEW', 'SALE', or 'DEBUG' on top of content.
how_to_use:
Banner(
  message: 'NEW',
  location: BannerLocation.topEnd,
  color: Colors.red,
  textStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
  child: Container(
    width: 200,
    height: 200,
    color: Colors.blue,
  ),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below the banner, which the banner will overlay.

properties.name: message
properties.description: The text to display on the banner.

properties.name: location
properties.description: The corner where the banner should appear.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The background color of the banner.

properties.name: textStyle
properties.description: The style to use for the banner message text.

properties.name: messageDirection
properties.description: The text direction of the message.
